protocol: For seed/event/j, SHA256 ASCII clef-snake-food-v1:{seed}:{event}:{j}, big-endian integer modulo j+1 gives Fisher-Yates swap index, j=143..1, starting row-major indices 0..143. Food event=score; choose first unoccupied cell. Full board retains original [0,0] fallback. Same priorities, not necessarily same future coordinates, across variants.
